articles.title: Record Rain Soaks South Florida
articles.summary: More than a foot of rain fell in parts of Broward County, closing roads, damaging a synagogue roof, and closing schools, as El Nino helped drive the storms.

articles.title: Trump Arrives in China for a First-Ever Meeting With Xi and Putin
articles.summary: President Trump landed in China for a historic Thursday meeting with the leaders of China and Russia, with trade, Ukraine, Iran, and nuclear weapons expected on the agenda.

articles.title: A Van Gogh Painting Sells for a Record $190.4 Million
articles.summary: Van Gogh's Chestnut Trees in Blossom sold for a record $190.4 million in New York, after a last-minute deal settled a fight about its past under the Nazis.
